_comment: Tells the app who 'me / my / mine' means. Put your own names, nicknames and initials under 'me', and other people (e.g. family members whose files should be hidden when you search 'my ...') under 'others'. Matching is case-insensitive against each file's name and extracted text. Lines starting with REPLACE_WITH are ignored, so replace them with real values. After editing, fully close and reopen the app for changes to take effect.
